description: Source code for the JobServer component managing workers and schedulers in the Mattermost server, including initialization, registration, start/stop operations, and cluster leadership handling.

classes.name: JobServer
classes.description: Main server managing job workers and schedulers, providing methods for registration, control, and cluster leadership handling.

methods.name: NewJobServer
methods.description: Constructor for JobServer, initializes workers and schedulers.

methods.name: initWorkers
methods.description: Initializes the workers component with watcher.

methods.name: initSchedulers
methods.description: Initializes the schedulers component with channels and maps.

methods.name: RegisterJobType
methods.description: Registers a new job type with associated worker and scheduler.

methods.name: StartWorkers
methods.description: Starts the worker processes if not already running.

methods.name: StartSchedulers
methods.description: Starts the scheduler processes if not already running.

methods.name: StopWorkers
methods.description: Stops the worker processes if running.

methods.name: StopSchedulers
methods.description: Stops the scheduler processes if running.

methods.name: HandleClusterLeaderChange
methods.description: Handles changes in cluster leadership status.
